release.scientific_scope: Global ETOPO 2022 v1 bedrock relief below mean sea level, aggregated with exact four-by-four interior source support.
limitations: Coastline and ocean coupling have not completed integrated validation.
This is not an independent bathymetry product and does not retain source-type identifiers.

release.scientific_scope: CHELSA-BIOCLIM+ 1981-2010 monthly land near-surface air-temperature normals.
limitations: It is land-only and leaves 18404 target cells without source support.
It supplies no precipitation, wind, humidity, sea ice, ocean climate, or weather dynamics.

release.scientific_scope: Natural Earth 1:10m generalized land membership as a global coastline cross-check.
limitations: It is generalized cartography rather than surveyed shoreline geometry.
Small islands and fine coastal features can be simplified or omitted.

release.scientific_scope: Global ETOPO 2022 v1 bedrock relief on land, aggregated with exact four-by-four interior source support.
limitations: It is provisionally downsampled and not yet coupled to higher-resolution terrain evidence.
Over ice sheets it represents bedrock rather than the physical surface.

release.scientific_scope: Copernicus 2022 observed LCCS classes with exact thirty-two-by-thirty-two class and quality support per L10 cell.
limitations: Cultivated and built-up classes still require counterfactual ecological reconstruction.
Surface classification is not habitat suitability or species-presence evidence.

release.scientific_scope: Uninterpreted JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 1984-2024 occurrence source codes at L10 cell centres.
limitations: It preserves 426256 out-of-source cells and 4054698 code-255 cells without interpretation.
It supplies no flow direction, drainage topology, freshwater dynamics, or human-water reconstruction.
The official unrestricted-use terms are identified online but their exact page bytes are not yet retained locally.

release.scientific_scope: Nine SoilGrids 2.0 zero-to-five-centimetre properties with retained Q0.05, Q0.5, and Q0.95 source values.
limitations: It is an approximately one-kilometre overview rather than native 250-metre or six-depth evidence.
Property units, cross-property coupling, and differing no-data footprints remain scientifically unvalidated.

release.scientific_scope: Content-addressed DE441 Sun, Earth, Moon, and planetary ephemerides plus IAU planetary constants and official NAIF usage rules.
limitations: Earth orientation and coupled coastal response remain pending.
Fixed-scale epochs still require independent comparison against a NAIF implementation.
No extrapolation beyond the retained DE441 coverage is permitted.

release.scientific_scope: Duplicate-checked catalog of 1822234 accepted real Animalia species from the frozen GBIF Backbone 2023-08-28.
limitations: Catalogue of Life XR crosswalk and DOI-backed commercially compatible occurrence evidence remain pending.
It supplies identity only, not range, abundance, physiology, ecology, behavior, or engine policy.
The retained source README identifies the release but does not itself reproduce the CC-BY terms.

release.scientific_scope: Content-addressed AnimalTraits, Amniote, and EltonTraits source artifacts for measured physiology, life history, and feeding ecology.
limitations: It is a source inventory rather than normalized species-trait evidence.
Per-field units, taxonomic crosswalks, inference flags, and scientific admission remain pending.
The exact Amniote and Elton terms pages are identified but not retained among the twelve source artifacts.

release.scientific_scope: Canonical catalog of independently compiled source-pinned fauna physiology profiles, including measured metabolic-rate observations.
limitations: It retains normalized evidence references rather than an ecological model.
Metabolic observations are source measurements, not environment-corrected energetic policies.
Profile coverage is incomplete and does not establish abundance, habitat suitability, or behavior.

coupled_validation_gaps: Animal occurrence, range inference, and ecological abundance are incomplete.
Climate lacks global ocean and dynamic weather variables.
Coupled energetics, ecology, movement, reproduction, and mortality are not implemented.
Cross-layer coastline, water, soil, habitat, and terrain reconstruction remains provisional.
Independent rebuilds and scientific review have not been completed.
Uncertainty propagation and assumption-ledger publication remain incomplete.
